notes: Complete international draughts (10×10, 20 pieces per side) with a Pygame board, forced captures, king promotion, and draw after 25 captures-less moves; human-vs-bot, bot-vs-bot, and win/draw accounting. Default config is human_vs_bot with the trained evolutionary agent (bot_used=2). CLEAN: MIT (Copyright 2026 Loris Sogliuzzo). UI uses SysFont only (no bundled TTF/OTF). No audio, EXE, DLL, or LFS. Upstream README notes the minimax bot is a stub (returns the first legal move) and reconnaissance_image.py is an exploratory script missing its input image; the default playable path does not depend on either. ~1.2M snapshot.
